scope.security_type: A-share ordinary equity, including delisted listings
scope.universe: Base 2.5.1 dwd_listing joined to dwd_listing_status_interval; source differences retained separately

sources.conflicts: Priority controls investigation order; retain differences and evidence-backed dispositions.
sources.astock: Issue 587 grants no blanket historical daily/factor/status admission.
sources.baostock_isST: Binary ST class only; ST/*ST/delisting-risk subtypes require separate evidence.

values.conversion: Native strings to Decimal; source lots/monetary scale converted once under source-specific evidence.
values.missing: Null remains missing. No invented bars, forward-filled OHLC, zero-volume substitutions or inferred suspensions.

time.knowledge_from: Retain source-proven knowledge times and their lineage; new retrospective observations without publication proof use first complete acquisition time.
time.observation_time: Trading date and close define the observation interval, separately from knowledge availability.
time.use_grade: 周期研究级，非历史 PIT 认证

coverage.denominator: Venue open sessions intersect each listing's effective listed interval and publication window; preserve code-reuse identities.
coverage.research_grade: Every unexplained missing listing/session is zero or individually evidenced and dispositioned.
coverage.reference_grade: Publish year/board coverage and machine-readable gaps.
coverage.status_before_regime: Use exchange-supported regime-effective evidence; otherwise UNKNOWN.
coverage.factor_seam: Bind method, direction and normalization anchor; explain factor changes through corporate actions and adjusted-price/return continuity.

storage.reference_tables: Follow each Base 2.5.1 table schema and effective-coordinate partitioning.
storage.raw: Retain source bytes, acquisition receipts and SHA256 outside Git.
storage.manifest: All published member paths, byte sizes and SHA256; READY follows completed acceptance.

budgets.stop_condition: A failed supplement qualification is recorded per capability; do not repeat the same request without a new evidence hypothesis.

materialization.bars: Preserve existing archive business keys and lexical values; supplement missing keys only. New provider tradestatus=0 produces suspension intervals without invented bars. Existing source zero-volume bars remain identifiable.
materialization.factor_field: BaoStock adjustFactor; same native cumulative basis as sealed Base 2.5.1.
materialization.factor_conflicts: Exact overlap differences are retained and reviewed before acceptance.
materialization.subtype: SPECIAL_TREATMENT: official SZSE historical name corroborated by provider isST=1 distinguishes ST and DELISTING_RISK. Unresolved class retains UNKNOWN.
materialization.official_name_clock: SHA-bound SZSE-ACQUISITION.json knowledge_verified_at, fixed once; never filesystem mtime.
materialization.scope: Market bars end 2019-12-31; identity/reference snapshots bind the sealed Base 2.5.1 revision.
